primary_gt.computed_interpretation: The record has three-product rainfall peak support, six disruption flags, nonzero exposure and infrastructure anchors, and two image-response checks above threshold.

criteria.name: Final JSON and label
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON and the rainfall-disruption-exposure response label.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for a recoverable JSON answer with a compatible but incomplete label.

criteria.name: Rainfall support
criteria.description: Computes the three-product rainfall support count and minimum peak-to-mean ratio correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for correct method with one product error.

criteria.name: Report flags
criteria.description: Counts the six report disruption flags correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for at least four correct flags.

criteria.name: Exposure and infrastructure
criteria.description: Reports the population total and OSM highway/amenity counts correctly, treating masked exposure and infrastructure statistics as package-authoritative and not judging them by internal coordinates or place names.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for one correct exposure component.

criteria.name: Image-response values
criteria.description: Computes the Sentinel-1 VV range and embedding max-to-mean ratio correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for one correct image-response metric.

criteria.name: Score ledger
criteria.description: Applies all five score tests and reports score_0_to_5 = 5.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for one test error with the same broad conclusion.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation tied to the computed ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for a longer but still numeric interpretation.

provenance.notes: WorldPop and OSM exposure files are treated as spatially masked products; derived statistics are authoritative, while absolute coordinates/place names/georeferencing are not event-location validity checks.
